subject: Vendor intake — policy deviation request (PO waiver) — Greenfold
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara@greenfold.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenfold.com
Date: 2026-10-31T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor intake - request to waive PO for pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get Redwood into a short pilot. We’re a small team and our procurement process is a bit manual for pilots: would Redwood consider routing invoices directly to procurement@greenfold.com for payment (invoice-only) rather than issuing a formal purchase order for the first 90-day pilot?

High-level:
- Pilot: 3 months, estimated spend ~$28k total
- Billing cadence: Net 30 invoices
- Point of contact: procurement@greenfold.com (cc’d)

I’ve attached our onboarding form and the draft SOW. If there are specific checkpoints you need (SOC2, certificate, W-9, or a signed waiver) we can get those over quickly.

Can you let me know what information you need to move forward and whether Redwood can make an exception for a PO on this pilot?

Appreciate it,

Sara Lopez
Head of Partnerships
Greenfold Inc.
(sara@greenfold.com)

Attachments: Greenfold_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Greenfold_Draft_SOW.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@greenfold.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - request to waive PO for pilot

Hi Sara — great to meet you (and thanks for sending the form).

Short answer: we can often support an invoice-only path for limited pilots, but we need to validate a few items and capture a short waiver so Finance has the right audit trail. Next steps from our side:

1) Internal quick review (team below) to confirm thresholds and required evidence
2) I’ll share our temporary PO-waiver form and the invoice-routing checklist
3) We’ll require a signed SOW and a copy of your SOC2 report or equivalent security attestation before we activate the waiver

I’ve looped in Sean (Finance) and Lauren (Legal intake) to confirm limits and any additional terms. Sean / Lauren — can you review the Greenfold intake and confirm if a 90-day, sub-$40k pilot is eligible for invoice-only routing? If there are conditions (e.g., prepayment hold, payment remittance account verification), please flag them and I’ll relay back.

Sara — attaching our standard temporary-waiver doc and the invoice path requirements. If that looks OK we can get the waiver signed via DocuSign and start the pilot onboarding.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Waiver_Form.docx, Redwood_temp-invoice-path.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - policy deviation for Greenfold (internal)

Marissa — quick notes from Finance after a first pass:

- Threshold: Finance is comfortable with invoice-only for pilots up to $40k provided Legal signs the waiver and procurement verifies payer identity.
- Required evidence: current W-9 (US), bank remittance confirmation, and SOC2/ISO attestation (redacted OK).
- Controls: limit to single PO-waiver per account for pilot; mark account "pilot-invoice-only" in billing system and require monthly spend reviews.
- Risk mitigation: hold last invoice for 15 business days after pilot completion in case of disputes, and require any renewals go through normal PO process.

If Legal (Lauren) signs off on the waiver language I’m good to approve. I’ve added a short clause to the waiver doc to capture the 15-day hold and the $40k cap.

-Sean

On Oct 31, 2026, at 11:02, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sara — great to meet you (and thanks for sending the form).
> ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@greenfold.com>, procurement@greenfold.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake - request to waive PO for pilot

Hi Sara & Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed internally and can make a one-time, temporary deviation for the 90-day pilot under the following conditions:

- Cap: total pilot invoices must not exceed $40,000
- Documentation: signed SOW and current W-9 on file; SOC2 or equivalent security attestation prior to activation
- Controls: account will be flagged "pilot-invoice-only"; Finance will hold the final invoice for 15 business days after pilot close for dispute review
- Billing: invoices should be sent to procurement@greenfold.com with our billing remit details included; Net 30 terms accepted

I’ve attached the signed waiver (DocuSign) and our invoice-routing checklist for your records. Please countersign the SOW and upload SOC2 evidence to the Drive link below so we can activate the pilot next week.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/Greenfold_Onboarding_Form
Signed waiver: https://redwood.docusign.com/waiver/abc123

If that works, I’ll have onboarding start the technical kickoff and share account-level billing controls.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: signed-waiver-docusign.pdf, Redwood_temp-invoice-path.pdf
